# Telltale 1.0.27

Added Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Italian and Dutch UI (11 languages total). German is now also available in Android Auto. These LLM translations were checked mechanically and reviewed by models, not native speakers; please report translation issues. No OBD or vehicle-logic changes.

Source: protected main `af786bd15e31cacc2f28280fc0e6e71abac3cf26`, pipeline `3020401133`. Signed Android artifacts use certificate SHA-256 `362133c004bee5e4f458f77d4a5d199948a3c5cdb9f0868be27d6f5d9109a579`; asset SHA-256 values are in SHA256SUMS.

The signed release APK passed the final phone smoke; the signed QA build passed the recorded phone, Android Auto DHU, and Wear emulator checks. No real vehicle validation was performed.
